text:
maria: CI on main is red — unit-tests job failed at the decrypt step. Error from the log: `KMS permission denied`. Anyone seen this before?

ci-bot: Build 1769508762 — job unit-tests — FAILED
https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/1769508762
```
> Error: failed to decrypt secret 'db/readonly'
> rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = KMS: permission denied for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ci-secrets
```

ashwin: @maria thanks for the heads up. do we know if the kms key was rotated or if the infra service account lost bindings? saw a rotate job yesterday afternoon.

maria: secrets-sync job ran ~2h before the build and succeeded, but i see a follow-up job `kms-rotate-check` failed in wheelchair. logs show a 403 when calling `projects/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1:decrypt`.

jen: likely IAM binding. check that `infra-ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on that key. quick check you can run: 
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ci-secrets --location=global --keyring=infra --project=redwood-prod
```

tom: if it's just a perm hole we can patch the binding and re-run. maria — can you try a manual rerun from the UI or `./scripts/ci rerun --build 1769508762 --job unit-tests`? sometimes a transient token fixes it.

maria: tried rerun via UI and via script, same failure. rerun log shows identical decrypt error — not flaky test.

sre-ops: noticed an automated token rotation at 1769501200 that updated short-lived creds for the deployments service. it's possible the rotation only updated deployer creds and missed the CI SA. i'm going to check the audit log for SetIamPolicy on that KMS key.

ashwin: i'm happy to bisect but since the failure happens before tests run (during secret decrypt) it's infra, not test flake. i'll open a quick infra PR to add an extra guard: if decrypt fails with 403, fallback to reading from the previously-cached secret (if available) and emit a clearer error. will also add a retry with exponential backoff.

jen: for immediate fix: either rebind the service account or temporarily add `roles/cloudkms.admin` to the SA for the key (then tighten after). prefer minimal binding: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` only. once patched, re-run the build.

maria: srec-ops — can you confirm if you want me to patch the binding or do you want to run the IAM revert?

sre-ops: i'll add the binding now and comment the change in the infra repo. will include the audit log link. give me 10–15m then retry.

ci-bot: Audit event: 1769508810 — SetIamPolicy on key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ci-secrets by infra-ops@redwood-inference — role removed: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for member serviceAccount:infra-ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

ashwin: that explains it. thanks @sre-ops for catching. please re-add the role binding and we should be green.

sre-ops: role binding re-added at 1769508897. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/921 (adds check to secrets-sync CI job)

maria: re-run kicked off -> build 1769508989. waiting on unit-tests.

ci-bot: Build 1769508989 — job unit-tests — STARTED

maria: tests passed. rerun succeeded. thanks all. i'll follow up with a short postmortem in #eng-infra for the rotation gap and add a checklist to the rotation runbook.

ashwin: i'll still add the fallback/retry PR to reduce blast radius for future short windows.

jen: nice coordination. :thumbsup:

ashwin: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-1423 — "CI: fallback to cached secrets on KMS 403 and add retry"

maria: closing the loop here. will paste runbook link once updated.
